_comment: Updated 2026-08-29 after Day 4. The 7B cliff sits between ctx 8192 and 16384. The two 14B context rows are the highest-value remaining experiment: with only one 14B point its slope is undetermined, and the slope shape is what separates the two candidate explanations for the unexplained per-token term (272 vs 439 KiB/token).
_parallel_axis_note:
The P=4 rows are NOT in runs: num_parallel here is recorded metadata only and does not configure the server. Run the P=1 matrix first, then set OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=4, restart Ollama and the terminal, and run these two by hand:
  lqb bench --model qwen2.5:7b --ctx 2048 --parallel 4 --label 7b-q4-ctx2048-p4
  lqb bench --model qwen2.5:7b --ctx 8192 --parallel 4 --label 7b-q4-ctx8192-p4
Then set it back to 1 and restart again. Cross-check: ctx2048-p4 must equal ctx8192-p1, and ctx8192-p4 must equal ctx32768-p1, byte for byte.
_flash_attention_note: OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION was tested on 2026-08-29 and made no measurable difference on Ollama 0.24 -- see results/day3_offload.md section 6. No row for it.
